annotations.title: Read a web page as Markdown

description: Fetches a public web page and returns its main content as Markdown, without navigation, adverts or scripts. For pages that build their content with JavaScript, set render to true.

images.description: When false, drops images from the output.

links.description: When false, replaces links with their text.

max_chars.description: Longest Markdown to return, in characters, from 1000 to 500000. Sent as 20000 when omitted. The reply says whether the text was cut short.

mode.description: `article` (default) keeps the main content. `full` converts the whole body.

render.description: When true, loads the page in a headless browser first.

name: read_webpage
title: Read a web page as Markdown
